record.label: Forward trace collision-plane identities
record.summary: For Z_GS=Sym(6 G tensor S), K4, K31, and K22 are explicit O(n^2) combinations of G,S and their diagonals. Multiple births, however, carry distinct transported metrics and generically grow one pair atom per injection.
